termIdstringBody · OptionalTerm to which the grade window or visibility applies.

endsAtstring date-timeBody · Required
enabledbooleanBody · Optional

gradeIdstringResponse

SMS-08-01 · Homeroom Record List

One notebook per class and academic year, created on first access. Switching terms preserves ID.

Database · Homeroom notebook

FieldTypeKeyNote
homeroom_notebook_idINTPKStable notebook identifier.
class_idINTFK, NOT NULLClass associated with this notebook.
academic_year_idINTFK, NOT NULLAcademic year associated with this notebook. The class and year identify one notebook.
homeroom_teacherINTFK, NULLABLEThe assigned teacher can access the notebook for their class.
authorized_principal_signINTFK, NULLABLELeadership reviewer authorized to sign the notebook comment.
notebook_formENUMNOT NULLThe school level determines the primary or secondary form.
created_atDATETIME—Creation time.
updated_atDATETIME—Time of last update.
updated_byINTFKUser who last updated this record.

Database · Leadership reviewer assignment

FieldTypeKeyNote
idINTPK, AUTO INCREMENTReviewer assignment identifier.
notebook_idINTFKNotebook the assignment applies to.
teacher_idUnspecifiedFKEligible member of school leadership assigned to review.
created_atTIMESTAMP—Time the reviewer was assigned.
statusBOOLEANDEFAULTActive on creation. Removing the assignment deactivates the record and retains history.

Proposed API · POST · Create or open the class-year notebook · HTTP 200

FieldTypeKeyNote
schoolIdstringPath · RequiredSchool context for the operation.
classIdstringBody · RequiredClass context for the notebook or released results.
gradeIdstringBody · Optional
yearIdstringBody · RequiredAcademic year context.
termIdstringBody · OptionalReporting term. Changing the term does not create another notebook.
Idempotency-KeystringHeader · RequiredA repeat request with the same key must preserve the result.
notebookIdstringResponseIdentifier of the existing or newly created notebook.
classIdstringResponseClass context for the notebook or released results.
yearIdstringResponseAcademic year context.
templateVersionstringResponseSchool-level notebook template selected for this class.
revisionstringResponse
